dashboard.settings.autoAcceptHelp: Orders will be confirmed automatically. If the requested time slot is full, the order is moved to the next available time slot. It confirms only when there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) you will need to confirm yourself.
dashboard.settings.layoutHelp: How items appear on the “Add order” screen.
dashboard.settings.layoutTabsHelp: Shows one category at a time. Tap a category to switch. Best for long menus; every item stays in the same place.
dashboard.settings.layoutScrollHelp: Shows all items in one scrolling list, with a heading for each category. There are no category buttons — scroll to move. Best for small menus; you can see most of it at once.
dashboard.settings.paidStepHelp: Adds a “Confirm” button when you add an order yourself, so you can place it now and take payment later.
dashboard.settings.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into two: “Cash” and “Card”.
dashboard.settings.orderReadyHelp: Shows a “Mark as ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens (KDS) are set separately. Every time an order is marked ready, the customer is sent an email.
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptTitle: Remind me to add a buzzer
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptHelp: Opens the buzzer number grid as soon as you place an order, so the number goes on the board while the customer is still in front of you. Even with this off, you can add a buzzer any time by tapping the order, but nothing will remind you. Useful where you hand out buzzers; easy to switch off where you do not.
dashboard.settings.cardsHelp: If you switch this off when there is a card problem, customers will order as usual and pay in person. Orders keep coming; only the card step stops.
dashboard.settings.cardsScope: This applies to your whole food truck business and to all events; it stays off until you switch it back on.
